prompt: Be quiet! The baby ___ (sleep) upstairs at the moment.
explanation: at the moment: la acción está en curso ahora, así que toca present continuous.

prompt: Right now I ___ (not / work); I am watching a film.
explanation: La negativa añade not al verbo be: am not working, nunca don't working.

prompt: Look! The cat ___ (lie) on my keyboard again.
explanation: Los verbos acabados en -ie cambian a -ying: lie → lying.

prompt: She ___ (write) an email to her boss at the moment.
explanation: Se cae la -e final antes de -ing: write → writing.

prompt: The children ___ (not / play) outside at the moment because it is raining.
This week Tom ___ (run) in the park every morning to train for the race.
explanation: this week marca algo temporal, y run dobla la consonante: running.

prompt: They are having dinner in the kitchen.
solution: They are not having dinner in the kitchen.
explanation: El not va detrás del verbo be: are not having. El auxiliar do no aparece.

prompt: He is waiting for the bus.
solution: Is he waiting for the bus?
explanation: El verbo be pasa delante del sujeto: Is he waiting?, no Does he waiting?

prompt: Sam is watching a film in his room right now.
explanation: right now señala una acción en curso: present continuous, no la rutina del present simple.

prompt: My sister is studying medicine this year.
explanation: this year describe una situación temporal, y eso pide present continuous.
